capabilities: Sync notes to a self-hosted Atomic server in the background
Search the vault semantically with hybrid keyword and vector search
Surface similar notes in a sidebar
Generate LLM wiki articles organized by tag hierarchy
Chat with the vault using an agentic RAG assistant
extras: Privacy notes: synced notes leave the vault to the configured server and its LLM provider; the API token is stored in plaintext in data.json. Mobile support depends on server reachability.
problem: Obsidian search is keyword-based and offers no semantic search, related-note suggestions, or LLM-driven summaries and chat over vault content.

relations.evidence: Atomic needs an LLM provider (OpenRouter or a local Ollama) configured on the server side
pair it with a local Ollama — nothing leaves your machine

requires.name: Atomic server (Atomic desktop app or self-hosted atomic-server)
LLM provider (OpenRouter key or local Ollama) on the server side

summary: Client for a self-hosted Atomic server that syncs vault notes for semantic search, similar-note discovery, AI wiki articles, chat, and a graph canvas.
